h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Anand

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Anand

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Anand

c: Anand is known across India for its dairy cooperative movement and for the colleges of Vallabh Vidyanagar next door. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Anand to college campuses, hostels, schools, cooperative housing colonies and municipal gardens. We manufacture the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, about 350 km away, and deliver it by road into central Gujarat.

College campuses in Anand often have wide open spaces but few fitness facilities outside the main sports ground. An open gym near the hostels gives students a place to train in the evening without a membership fee. Plan it near a lit path, since most students exercise after classes. Central Gujarat gets hot, dry summers and a short, heavy monsoon. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats handle both. For a campus, grouted installation is usually the right choice, because each post is set in concrete and stands up to heavy daily use.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 350 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can a college in Vallabh Vidyanagar order an outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. Share the space near your hostels and a few photos. We send a layout drawing and quote, then manufacture at our Vasai factory and install by road.

items.q: How many students can use an open gym at once?
items.a: That depends on the machines. Double and three-way stations let several people train at once. Tell us the expected numbers and we will plan enough stations.

items.q: Is grouting or self-standing better for a busy campus?
items.a: Grouting is usually better for heavy use, because each post is set firmly in concrete. Self-standing suits paved areas where digging is not possible.
